node_desc_output: Final shader output node. The connected color is written to fragColor — what is visible on screen. Accepts vec4 (RGBA).
node_desc_time: Elapsed time in seconds since start (iTime). Use it to create cyclic animations with sin(t) or cos(t).
node_desc_uv: Normalized UV coordinates of the current fragment (0..1). Equivalent to gl_FragCoord.xy / iResolution.xy. Useful for patterns that adapt to screen size.
node_desc_resolution: Current viewport resolution in pixels (iResolution). Use it to compute aspect ratio or screen-space coordinates.
node_desc_mouse: Normalized mouse position (0..1) relative to the viewport. Enables interactive effects that react to cursor movement.
node_desc_fragcoord: Raw fragment coordinates in pixels (gl_FragCoord.xy). Unlike UV, not normalized; ranges from (0,0) to (width, height).
node_desc_texture: Samples texture channel 0 (iChannel0) at the given UV coordinates. Returns a vec4 RGBA. Connect UV or custom coordinates to the input.
node_desc_color: RGB color constant. Each channel (r, g, b) accepts values from 0.0 to 1.0. Use as a base color, tint, or mask in blends.
node_desc_float: Constant floating-point scalar. Useful as a scale factor, threshold, intensity, or any numeric shader parameter.
node_desc_vec2: Constant 2D vector. Use it for 2D directions, offsets, XY scales, or fixed coordinates in UV space.
node_desc_add: Component-wise addition: out = A + B. Combine colors, add offsets, or accumulate signals.
node_desc_subtract: Component-wise subtraction: out = A - B. Compute color differences, direction vectors, or center coordinates.
node_desc_multiply: Component-wise multiplication: out = A * B. Scale colors, apply masks, or modulate one signal by another.
node_desc_divide: Component-wise division: out = A / B. Watch out for division by zero. Useful for normalizing ranges or computing ratios.
node_desc_mix: Linear interpolation: out = A*(1-t) + B*t. t=0 returns A, t=1 returns B. Perfect for smooth transitions between colors or values.
node_desc_step: Step function: returns 0 if x < edge, 1 if x >= edge. Creates hard edges, binary masks, or color thresholds.
node_desc_smoothstep: Hermite smooth interpolation between e0 and e1. Produces an S-curve that avoids the sharp edges of step(). Widely used for transitions and antialiasing.
node_desc_clamp: Clamps x to the range [min, max]: out = clamp(x, min, max). Prevents values from going out of range. Essential to keep colors in 0..1.
node_desc_power: Power: out = base^exp (pow). Apply gamma correction, create contrast curves, or generate non-linear gradients.
node_desc_sqrt: Square root: out = sqrt(x). Useful in distance, energy calculations, or to smooth values. Requires x >= 0.
node_desc_mod: Modulo: out = x mod y. Creates repeating patterns (tiles), cycles, or keeps values within a periodic range.
node_desc_min: Component-wise minimum: out = min(A, B). Returns the smallest value in each channel. Useful for SDF intersections or limiting signals.
node_desc_max: Component-wise maximum: out = max(A, B). Returns the largest value in each channel. Useful for SDF unions or amplifying signals.
node_desc_sin: Sine: out = sin(x). Produces smooth oscillations between -1 and 1. Connect Time to animate, or UV coordinates for wave patterns.
node_desc_cos: Cosine: out = cos(x). Similar to Sin but 90 degrees phase-shifted. Use sin and cos together for circular motion or 2D patterns.
node_desc_abs: Absolute value: out = |x|. Converts negative values to positive. Creates fold or symmetry effects when applied to coordinates.
node_desc_fract: Fractional part: out = x - floor(x). Returns values in [0, 1). Creates infinite tiles or sawtooth patterns by multiplying UV coordinates.
node_desc_floor: Floor: out = floor(x). Rounds down to the nearest integer. Combined with Fract, gives access to the tile cell in tiling patterns.
node_desc_length: Vector length (magnitude): out = length(v). Returns a scalar. Fundamental for distance calculations and SDFs (Signed Distance Functions).
node_desc_normalize: Normalizes the vector to length 1: out = v / length(v). Essential for lighting, reflections, or any unit direction.
node_desc_dot: Dot product: out = dot(A, B) = sum(A*B). Measures directional similarity between two vectors. Key for diffuse lighting (N·L).
node_desc_cross: Cross product: out = cross(A, B). Returns a vector perpendicular to both A and B. Useful for computing surface normals.
node_desc_reflect: Reflection: out = reflect(I, N). Computes the reflected direction of ray I with respect to normal N. Basis for mirror effects and raymarching.
node_desc_distance: Euclidean distance between two points: out = length(A - B). Equivalent to Length of the difference. Useful in SDFs and proximity effects.
node_desc_combine_xyz: Builds a vec3 from three scalars: out = vec3(X, Y, Z). Useful to combine independent color channels or create custom 3D vectors.
node_desc_combine_xyzw: Builds a vec4 from four scalars: out = vec4(X, Y, Z, W). W is usually alpha. Required to connect to the Output node.
node_desc_split: Decomposes a vec4 into four scalar components (x, y, z, w). Lets you process each channel independently.
node_desc_remap: Scale and offset: out = x * scale + offset. Remap ranges (e.g. -1..1 to 0..1) or apply linear transformations to signals.
node_desc_one_minus: Complement: out = 1 - x. Inverts colors, masks, and normalized values. Very useful for negating a signal's influence.
node_desc_negate: Negation: out = -x. Flips the sign of all components. Useful to reverse directions, invert offsets, or create symmetry.
node_desc_noise: Pseudo-random noise based on sin/fract. Generates organic textures, static, or random variation from coordinates. Not Perlin noise, but efficient.
slot_desc_output_color: Final color output (RGBA). vec4: X=R, Y=G, Z=B, W=Alpha. All channels in 0..1 for standard display. Connects to fragColor.
slot_desc_time_t: Time in seconds (float). Increases every frame. Multiply by speed to control animation rate.
slot_desc_uv_uv: UV coordinates (vec2). X=horizontal (0=left, 1=right), Y=vertical (0=bottom, 1=top). Normalized to viewport size.
slot_desc_resolution_res: Viewport resolution in pixels (vec2). X=width, Y=height. Divide FragCoord by this to get UV.
slot_desc_mouse_mouse: Mouse position (vec2) normalized to 0..1. X=horizontal, Y=vertical. Click-and-drag to interact.
slot_desc_fragcoord_coord: Fragment pixel coordinates (vec2). Not normalized — in pixel units. X goes 0..width, Y goes 0..height.
slot_desc_texture_uv: UV coordinates to sample the texture (vec2). Usually connect the UV input node or custom coordinates.
slot_desc_texture_color: Sampled color from iChannel0 (vec4, RGBA). Each channel in 0..1.
slot_desc_color_rgb: RGB color output (vec3). R=red, G=green, B=blue. Each channel in 0..1.
slot_desc_float_val: Scalar float value. Single number — no direction or multiple components.
slot_desc_vec2_vec: 2D vector (vec2). X and Y components. Can represent a 2D point, direction, or UV offset.
slot_desc_generic_A: Input A (vec3). First operand. Can be a color (RGB) or any 3-component vector.
slot_desc_generic_B: Input B (vec3). Second operand. Can be a color (RGB) or any 3-component vector.
slot_desc_math_out: Result (vec3). Output of the operation, component-wise.
slot_desc_mix_A: First value to interpolate (vec3). Returned when t=0.
slot_desc_mix_B: Second value to interpolate (vec3). Returned when t=1.
slot_desc_mix_t: Blend factor (float). 0=return A, 1=return B. Values between 0 and 1 blend both inputs.
slot_desc_step_edge: Threshold (vec3). Below this value the output is 0, at or above it is 1.
slot_desc_smoothstep_e0: Lower edge of the smooth transition (vec3). Output is 0 when x <= e0.
slot_desc_smoothstep_e1: Upper edge of the smooth transition (vec3). Output is 1 when x >= e1.
slot_desc_unary_x: Input value (vec3). The value to transform — can be a color or 3D vector.
slot_desc_clamp_min: Minimum bound (vec3). Output is never less than this. Default: vec3(0,0,0).
slot_desc_clamp_max: Maximum bound (vec3). Output is never greater than this. Default: vec3(1,1,1).
slot_desc_pow_base: Base value (vec3). The value being raised to the exponent. Must be >= 0.
slot_desc_pow_exp: Exponent (vec3). Power to raise the base to. 2.0=square, 0.5=square root, etc.
slot_desc_mod_y: Divisor (vec3). The value x is divided by to produce the remainder. Must be non-zero.
slot_desc_trig_x: Angle in radians (vec3). 2pi = full cycle. Multiply UV or Time to control frequency.
slot_desc_trig_out: Trigonometric result (vec3). Each component independently in range -1..1.
slot_desc_vec_v: Input vector (vec3). The 3D vector to operate on.
slot_desc_length_out: Vector length (float). Always >= 0. Represents the distance from the origin to the vector tip.
slot_desc_normalize_out: Unit vector (vec3). Same direction as input, but with length exactly 1.
slot_desc_dot_A: First vector for dot product (vec3). Typically a surface normal or direction.
slot_desc_dot_B: Second vector for dot product (vec3). Typically a light direction or another normal.
slot_desc_dot_out: Dot product result (float). Range: -1..1 for unit vectors. 1=same direction, 0=perpendicular, -1=opposite.
slot_desc_cross_A: First vector for cross product (vec3). One edge of the reference plane.
slot_desc_cross_B: Second vector for cross product (vec3). Second edge of the reference plane.
slot_desc_cross_out: Perpendicular vector (vec3). Points in the direction given by the right-hand rule.
slot_desc_reflect_I: Incident ray direction (vec3). The incoming ray or direction to reflect. Should be normalized.
slot_desc_reflect_N: Surface normal (vec3). The normal of the surface at the reflection point. Should be normalized.
slot_desc_reflect_out: Reflected direction (vec3). The direction after bouncing off the surface.
slot_desc_dist_out: Distance between A and B (float). Always >= 0.
slot_desc_combine_X: X component (float). First component of the resulting vector.
slot_desc_combine_Y: Y component (float). Second component of the resulting vector.
slot_desc_combine_Z: Z component (float). Third component of the resulting vector.
slot_desc_combine_W: W component (float). Fourth component. Usually Alpha (1.0=opaque, 0.0=transparent).
slot_desc_combine4_out: Assembled vec4 (X, Y, Z, W). Can be connected to the Output node.
slot_desc_split_in: Input vec4 to decompose (X, Y, Z, W channels).
slot_desc_split_x: X component (float) extracted from the input vec4.
slot_desc_split_y: Y component (float) extracted from the input vec4.
slot_desc_split_z: Z component (float) extracted from the input vec4.
slot_desc_split_w: W component (float) extracted from the input vec4. Usually Alpha.
slot_desc_remap_x: Value to remap (vec3). The input signal to scale and offset.
slot_desc_remap_scale: Scale multiplier (vec3). Multiplied by x before adding offset. Default: vec3(1,1,1).
slot_desc_remap_offset: Additive offset (vec3). Added after scaling. Default: vec3(0,0,0).
slot_desc_noise_pos: Input position (vec3). Usually UV or FragCoord. Different positions produce different noise values.
